PID_FILE="/var/run/my-worker.pid"

    rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    exit 0

        echo "Removing stale PID file from previous non-graceful termination."
        rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    fi
fi

# Write our current PID
echo "$$" > "$PID_FILE"
echo "Service started with PID $$ (Recorded in $PID_FILE)."
